entry.summary:
There's a type of insurance that some think can be a bit of a "rip-off", says RNZ's Susan Edmunds | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

The No Stupid Questions podcast takes a look at funeral insurance - including some extreme cases where people were paying up to double the amount they were due to be paid out in premiums.

Listen to the podcast 🎧: https://www.rnz.co.nz/podcast/no-stupid-questions
